text:
Eli (Finance Ops): FYI Helixa.ai INV-2025-113 is overdue (45 days). Card charged & declined last week. They emailed asking for a short-term plan — CFO offered 3 payments. Thoughts?

Tess (Account Executive): They're in the middle of a funding round, CFO says bank transfer only. Usage trending up; high value if we keep them. Customer proposes: 40% now (wire), 30% in 30d, 30% in 60d.

Ravi (Collections): We need a PO or signed email from CFO. No partials without docs. Also want a traceable payment method (wire confirmation).

Eli (Finance Ops): No PO in portal. Marta says she'll send PO + CFO note.

Nora (Collections Lead): If we get PO + wire for first tranche within 72h, Collections will accept 3-pay plan. Conditions: upload PO to billing@redwood.com, receipt for wire, and agreement to a 1% monthly admin fee on outstanding balance. If terms not met, we schedule account suspension in 7 days.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-113 | Amount: $42,750 | Due: 2025-09-18 | Status: Past due (45d) | Last payment: none

Tess (Account Executive): Marta just sent the PO screenshot and said wire initiated. She asked if we can waive late fees if they follow schedule.

Ravi (Collections): Fine to waive accrued late fees once proof of wire is posted and PO received. I will create the payment-plan ticket and tag the account with "payment-plan-3x".

Marta (Helixa.ai): Confirming CFO signed PO attached. Bank says same-day wire; will upload receipt ASAP. Thanks for flexibility.

Eli (Finance Ops): Received wire confirmation 8 hours later for $17,100 (40%). Marked partial payment. Created payment plan helixa-3x-INV-2025-113. Next reminder in 30 days.

Nora (Collections Lead): Logged in tracker. If installment 2 misses, escalate to legal and place account on hold.

Tess (Account Executive): Customer sent appreciation note. Good retention win.

Eli (Finance Ops): Closing thread for now, keeping records for audit.
